## Decisions (recorded at implementation)

- **One list, three surfaces is literal**: `DossierPage` computes `visibleDossierFindings(dossier,
  filters)` once — severity budget first, then the GET-param filters — and the body list, the
  Margin body, and the Desk body all render from that array. No per-surface re-derivation.
- **The Desk is the a11y surface**: Margin decorations + card rail are aria-hidden/by-anchored;
  the Desk findings table is the real `<table>` landmark carrying the full action set.
- **Apply rides mirror, not a second write path**: `saveManualRevision` gained a
  `provenanceMark` arg so the Apply route splices markdown → marks the touched block
  `suggestion_applied` (carrying `runId` + `findingId`) → records the disposition in the same tx.
  The frozen-head fork is the existing `human_revision` machinery — nothing new.
- **Bulk dispatch honors `only[]`** — the preview's unchecked rows are never written; apply-style
  bulks write ONE revised markdown and one disposition per applied row.
- **Free-form obligations** (`source:'user'`, standing): api `POST /projects/:id/obligations`
  (title required; severity defaults `minor`; opens on the head draft), web GET/POST form pair
  `/p/:slug/obligations/new`, palette "Go to" row navigates there (the palette stays GET-only —
  the form does the write).
- **Compact keeps the phone contract** (§10.1): `compact` renders suppress bulk affordances —
  the same five verbs + note only.
- **Provisional rows never get controls**: `canDispose` gates Margin card, Desk row, and body
  list alike (the six-form fixture assertion documents the three-surface parity).
- **Findings never mutate the markdown** (P1.02 invariant re-checked): decorations, sidecars, and
  the read-only suggestion-preview DOM are the only render paths; the ONE write is Apply's
  explicit `saveManualRevision`.
